_comment: Golden fixtures: asking instead of acting, and refusing instead of guessing (PLAN-metalstorm-command-language.md §1, §5). Two distinct sources of a question: the MODEL asks (`clarify` on the envelope, actions empty), or the RESOLVER asks (a well-formed envelope whose refs are ambiguous — synthesized client-side, no second LLM call). Both must end with a question and zero sends.

fixtures.name: the model asks, with chips
fixtures.note: clarify ⇒ actions must be empty — the validator enforces it. Asking and acting are exclusive; a question that also fires an order asks about something already done.

clarify.question: Which tank squads — Chimera, Basilisk or Warhound?
Which gate — Northgate or Fallow Gate?

fixtures.name: the resolver asks: two squads fit the name equally
fixtures.note: THE unforgivable-failure guard. 'Chimera' prefix-matches both squads; the strict force rule asks even when one would score higher, because a points win is not evidence about which squad the player meant.

fixtures.name: the resolver asks: two places tie
fixtures.note: Places resolve on outright score dominance. 'Rand' prefix-matches both cities at the same tier, so there is no winner and it asks.

fixtures.name: an exact match beats the tie it sits inside
fixtures.note: The other half of the rule: 'Randtown' is an exact hit, so the fuzzy tier — where 'Randtown East' also matches — is never consulted. Ambiguity must not make a precise sentence unusable.

fixtures.name: the resolver asks: fewer squads than the sentence wanted
fixtures.note: The plan's 'I only have one tank squad — send Chimera Squad alone?'. Sending one when two were asked for is a decision the player has to make.

fixtures.name: no candidates at all is a refusal, not an offer to auto-form
no unit-class lookup means no class-count order
fixtures.note: What the live client hits TODAY: the widget context has no defs mirror, so which squads are tank squads is unknowable. Refuses with that reason instead of taking the first two groups.

saysLike: isn't wired up on the client

fixtures.name: an unknown place refuses; it does not fuzzy-match into the void
an empty board refuses every reference
the model refuses out of scope
fixtures.utterance: resign and start a new game

actions.reason: I can't leave or start matches from here — use the menu.

fixtures.name: a route verb has no sentence form yet
fixtures.note: `patrol` and `screen` accept shape 'route' alone and the envelope has no multi-point target. Refused by name rather than silently downgraded to a one-point patrol, which would look like a patrol and behave like a move.

fixtures.name: an on-sight standing order has no wire slot
fixtures.utterance: if you see Chimera squad, follow it
fixtures.note: A plan §0 example utterance, and an honest gap: WhenCondition has no sighting case and the sim evaluates no sighting predicate. Sending the directive without its trigger would fire it immediately — the opposite of what was asked.

fixtures.name: a selection subject with nothing selected refuses
fixtures.note: The model was told there was a selection and there wasn't (a stale context, or a model that assumed). Refuses rather than silently widening to team-wide, because 'everything I own attacks Slag Forge' is not what was asked.

fixtures.name: a multi-class role can't fill a single-class idle filter
fixtures.note: 'air defense' spans staticdefense(scale≥2) ∪ fighters and `filterClass` holds one class. Picking a branch would be a guess; refused with what to say instead.

saysLike: spans more than one unit class

fixtures.name: guidance on a region nobody has heard of
